post.description: Changes the signed-in user's password after verifying the current one, then revokes every refresh token so all sessions must re-authenticate.
Emails a password-reset link if the address matches an active account. Always succeeds, so the response cannot be used to probe which emails are registered.
Ends the current impersonation session and restores the administrator session by refreshing the preserved admin refresh cookie.

parameters.description: Bearer access token of the impersonation session
parameters.name: Authorization

parameters.name: Cookie

post.description: Starts impersonating another user. Requires an administrator (the * permission); administrators cannot be impersonated. Returns an impersonation session and sets the access cookie, leaving the admin's refresh cookie intact so the session can be restored.

parameters.description: Bearer access token of an administrator
parameters.name: Authorization

parameters.description: Id of the user to impersonate

get.description: Returns the profile for the bearer access token.

patch.description: Updates the calling user's own profile fields (displayName, avatarUrl, phone, jobTitle, company). Status and role assignments are not editable through this path — those require an admin via PATCH /api/users/{id}.

post.description: Verifies the first authenticator code, turns MFA on, and returns one-time recovery codes (shown only once).
Generates a new TOTP secret for the current user and returns an otpauth URI + the raw secret. MFA is not active until the code is confirmed.
Rotates the refresh token cookie and returns a new access token. Refused (409) while impersonating — use the stop-impersonation endpoint instead.

parameters.description: Bearer access token, if any; used to refuse refresh during impersonation
parameters.name: Authorization

schema.description: Bearer access token, if any; used to refuse refresh during impersonation

post.description: Issues a fresh email-verification link for the signed-in user. A no-op when the email is already verified.
Sets a new password using a token from the forgot-password email, then revokes every session for the account.
post.summary: Reset a password with a token

post.description: Authenticates credentials, returns an access token, and sets the refresh token cookie.
Revokes the current refresh token cookie when present.
Revokes every other active session for the current user, keeping the calling device signed in. Requires the current refresh token cookie to identify which session to keep.

parameters.description: Refresh token cookie identifying the session to keep
parameters.name: Cookie

post.description: Creates a user account, returns an access token, and sets the refresh token cookie.
